sentences.en: His thick black wavy hair was swept back with deliberate carelessness.
sentences.zh: 他那头浓密的黑色波浪发被刻意地向后梳着。

sentences.en: My wife deliberated whether we would buy a new house or not.
sentences.zh: 我妻子权衡了一下我们是否要买新房子。

sentences.en: We deliberated whether we should cancel the reservation.
sentences.zh: 我们斟酌要不要取消预订。

senses.zh: 故意的, 蓄意的 - 慎重的, 深思熟虑的 - 不慌不忙的, 从容不迫的 -
仔细考虑 - 研讨, 商讨
